summary: Tested new vision card-scan feature end-to-end. Backend: 3/3 pytest passed for POST /api/recognize-cards (non-image rejected 400, empty body handled, /tmp/test_cards.jpg returns exactly 4 distinct valid cards). Frontend: scan-photo-btn triggers hidden photo-input; uploading /tmp/test_cards.jpg via set_input_files updates card-trigger-1..4 with detected cards (A-S, K-D, 10-D, 7-S in this run) and decision-panel auto-re-evaluates to formula 'L1 + H3 + F2 - R1 = 5, play'. Regression: reset-btn restores DEFAULT_HAND, URL ?hand=AS-KS-2H-3H loads Premium hand (9/9), share popover exposes share-link-btn & share-summary-btn.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined AFTER recognize_cards() at module bottom (line 405) but is referenced inside the handler for error logging (lines 371, 377). It works at runtime because logger is resolved lazily on call, but this is fragile — move logging.basicConfig + logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) to the top of the module.

recognize-cards: _parse_cards_json can raise json.JSONDecodeError which is caught and mapped to 422 'Could not read the cards clearly.' — good. However if the model returns 4 cards but some are invalid (rank/suit skipped by filter), the resulting list is <4 and yields 422 'Expected 4 cards but detected N' — acceptable but might benefit from a retry.
MongoDB motor client is still initialized on import though the app is stateless — dead code / connection overhead.
Photo scan flow works but there is no client-side max-file-size guard; large images could stall the UI and hit the vision provider's payload limits. Consider a ~8 MB soft cap with toast.

In Evaluator.jsx onPhotoSelected, after a successful scan the toast success text says 'Cards detected! Check and adjust if needed.' which is good UX; consider also focusing/highlighting any card the user should verify.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY configured in backend/.env.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vision endpoint uses openai/gpt-5.4 via emergentintegrations. Recognition is stochastic — assert only that 4 valid distinct cards are returned, not specific ranks/suits. Frontend hidden input has data-testid=photo-input; drive via page.set_input_files rather than clicking scan-photo-btn. Auto-evaluate is debounced 250ms.
